description: This file contains platform-specific upgrade and configuration functions for various hardware devices in an OpenWrt router firmware context. It defines upgrade procedures for different device models and includes logic to select the appropriate upgrade method based on the board name.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: A simple function that always returns success, used to verify image validity.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade function that selects the appropriate upgrade procedure based on the device's board name.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies device-specific configuration using platform-specific methods.
